name: Job Seeker
description: Cover letters, networking, interview prep, and job search communication templates
author: Fountain Team

macros.expansion:
Hi {input:Name},

I hope this message finds you well! I came across your profile and was impressed by your experience in {input:Field}.

I'm currently {input:Your situation - exploring opportunities/transitioning/etc.} and would love to learn more about your journey at {input:Company}.

Would you have 15-20 minutes for a virtual coffee chat? I'd really value your insights.

Thank you for considering!

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

Hi {input:Name},

I noticed we share {input:Connection/Interest}. I'm currently {input:Your situation} and am very interested in {input:Company/Role/Industry}.

I'd love to connect and learn from your experience!

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

Dear {input:Interviewer Name},

Thank you for taking the time to meet with me today about the {input:Position} role.

I enjoyed learning more about {input:Something specific discussed}. Our conversation reinforced my excitement about the opportunity to {input:How you'd contribute}.

I'm particularly enthusiastic about {input:Specific aspect of role/company}.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need any additional information. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

Dear {input:Name},

I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to follow up on my application for the {input:Position} role submitted on {input:Date}.

I remain very interested in the opportunity and believe my experience in {input:Relevant area} would make me a strong contributor to your team.

Is there any additional information I can provide? I'd welcome the chance to discuss my qualifications further.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

Hi {input:Name},

I hope you're doing well! I saw that {input:Company} is hiring for a {input:Position} role, and I'm very interested.

Given your experience there, I was hoping you might be willing to refer me or share any insights about the role/team.

I've attached my resume for reference. I'd be happy to chat if you'd like to learn more about my background first.

Thanks so much for considering!

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

Dear {input:Name},

Thank you so much for offering me the {input:Position} role at {input:Company}.

After careful consideration, I have decided to {input:pursue another opportunity/decline for personal reasons/etc.}.

This was not an easy decision. I was impressed by {input:Positive about company} and enjoyed meeting the team.

I hope our paths cross again in the future.

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

Dear {input:Name},

Thank you for the offer for the {input:Position} role. I'm very excited about the opportunity to join {input:Company}.

Before accepting, I'd like to discuss the compensation package. Based on my research and experience, I was hoping for a salary in the range of ${input:Range}.

{input:Brief justification}

I'm confident we can find a mutually beneficial arrangement. I'm open to discussing this further.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

Dear {input:Name},

Thank you for considering me for the {input:Position} role at {input:Company}.

After careful thought, I have decided to withdraw my application. {input:Brief reason if appropriate}

I appreciate the time you and the team spent with me during the interview process. I was impressed by {input:Positive}.

I wish you success in finding the right candidate.

Best regards,
{input:Your Name}

**Questions to Ask the Interviewer:**

1. What does success look like in this role in the first 90 days?
2. What are the biggest challenges facing the team right now?
3. How would you describe the team culture?
4. What do you enjoy most about working here?
5. What are the opportunities for growth and development?
6. What are the next steps in the interview process?
